_about: Dataset documents of the Market Signals Dashboard (Claude Dashboard artifact). ids = JSON file names written by pipeline.py. The morning run only updates source.url, source.name and updated.
schedule: Rebuilt each weekday morning before 6 AM Central by a scheduled Claude task from the GitHub data feed

gauges.title: Oversold / overbought gauges
gauges.description: QQQ, IVV and the Dow: a 0–100 short-term stretch score from RSI(14), Bollinger %B and the distance from the 20-day mean in ATR units, with the status label and inputs, computed by pipeline.py from the GitHub feed.

allocation.title: Recommended allocation
allocation.description: One row per fund: the plan's target, the holdings on file marked to the last close, and the trade between them, computed by plan.py from the rules and the GitHub feed.

plan.title: Plan rules, where they stand
plan.description: The drawdown episode, ladder tranche levels, 200-day reclaim gate, leveraged-sleeve size, reserve mix, intraday watch and the rolling backtest behind the rules, one row each.

summary.title: Today's summary and scores
summary.description: One row: regime light, dip-buy and heat scores, the rule-based action, headline prices and data status, computed by pipeline.py from the GitHub feed (Yahoo Finance/Stooq prices, FRED, Cboe).

metrics.title: The 50 signal metrics
metrics.description: Each metric's value, signal, 1-year percentile, reading and source, in eight layers; computed by pipeline.py from the raw data in the GitHub feed.

series.title: Daily series, two years
series.description: Prices, moving averages, drawdowns, oscillators, volatility, breadth, credit, rates, liquidity, gas and the historical composite scores, one row per trading day for charts.

sectors.title: Sector rotation table
sectors.description: Eleven S&P sector ETFs: returns and relative performance versus IVV over 1, 3, 6 and 12 months, rotation quadrant and z-score, from adjusted closes in the GitHub feed.

composite_parts.title: Composite score components
composite_parts.description: How the regime light, dip-buy score and heat score were assembled today: each component's reading, weight and contribution.

backtest.title: Score backtest by band
backtest.description: Average and median forward returns, share positive and edge versus all days, for QQQ and TQQQ* (actual from 2010, simulated 3x before) by dip- and heat-score band and horizon since 1999.

backtest_curve.title: Strategy growth curves
backtest_curve.description: Monthly growth of 100 since 2005 for QQQ, TQQQ* buy-and-hold and TQQQ* held only while QQQ is above its 200-day average.

backtest_stats.title: Strategy statistics
backtest_stats.description: CAGR, maximum drawdown, volatility and Sharpe ratio for each backtested strategy.

events.title: Upcoming macro events
events.description: Next CPI, FOMC and payrolls dates from the Federal Reserve and BLS calendars, plus configured mega-cap earnings dates.

sources.title: Data feed status
sources.description: Status, last data date and fetch time of every source the GitHub Action pulled this morning (data/manifest.json).

insights.title: Today's ten insights
insights.description: The ranked insights and actions Claude wrote this morning from the metrics, each with its category, metric ids and, where testable, the prediction and stated confidence.

insight_log.title: Every past call and its outcome
insight_log.description: All insights written so far with their predictions, scored hit or miss from the asset's open on the insight date to the close after the horizon, or pending.

scorecard.title: Insight scorecard
scorecard.description: Hit rate, average signed move and Brier score of the morning calls, overall and by horizon, category, confidence band and asset.

score_history.title: Daily scores and what followed
score_history.description: Each morning's regime light, dip and heat scores with the QQQ return over the following 5, 10 and 20 sessions as they become known (live calibration).
